title: Obtainable Operators
description: A Datapack that lets you craft some uncraftable blocks like Bedrock and Command Blocks.
body:
Obtainable Operators is a Data Pack that allows survival users to obtain blocks like Barriers and Command Blocks, this also allows the crafting of the elusive Debug Stick!

**Crafting**
- Command Block (Impulse, Repeating, Chain, & Minecart)
- Structure Block
- Jigsaw Block
- Bedrock
- Structure Void
- Barrier
- Light Block
- Debug Stick

**Advancements**
- Careful Where You Place It! (Obtain Bedrock)
- Where Is It? (Place a Structure Void)
- Found It! Did I? (Place a Barrier)
- Constructor (Obtain a Structure Block)
- Wrench (Obtain a Debug Stick)
- Let There Be Light! (Place a Light Block)
- Operator Variation (Have Every Command Block Variant in the Inventory)
